The sharks are positioned side-by-side with their heads facing the camera, displaying their characteristic cephalofoils. The water is blue with some white foam around the subjects.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both sharks clearly display the iconic T-shaped, laterally expanded head structure typical of hammerheads.
